(shrī)༄༅/ /dpal mgon bram nag gam nag po dam 'chang gi bram nag shan pa drug skor gyi rjes gnang dbang rab kyi zin/zin bzhugs/ /༈/pad nyi dang dag

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// dpal mgon bram nag gam nag po dam 'chang gi

bram nag shan pa drug skor gyi rjes gnang dbang rab kyi zin/ zin bzhugs// ༈ /pad nyi dang dgra bgegs kyi ro'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs sku mdog nag po g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ mi rus kyi phreng ba phyag 'gag tu brgyus pa/ chang gis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du bsnams pa/ mdung dang rtse gsum yang mchan khung du bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ smin ma dmar ser me ltar du 'bar ba/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gi do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ rus pa'i phreng ba skya cheb bes brgyan pa/ stag gis pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i 'khor du las mkhan bshan pa drug po yang phyag g.yas pas phyag mtshan sna tshogs bsnams pa/ g.yon pas mda' gzhu khyi khrid byed pa/ shin tu rngams shing 'khrugs pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsung ngo*// 'di'i rjes gnang la gtor ma zur gsum che ba la me ri sogs gzab par brgyan pa'i mthar bshos bu zur gsum chung ba drug gis bskor ba sogs mdzad/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsol gdab gsum/ maṇ+ḍal/ rgyun bshags/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab gsum/ rjes gnang dngos la/ slob ma bram nag tu bskyed pa'i 'khor du bshan pa drug gis bskor ba'i gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ ḍa dril spos bcas sku/ gsung la bzlas lung la yum bzhi'i sngags spangs pa'i sngags thung ngam/ glo bur du las 'chol ba'i sngags kho na gsum/ bcom ldan 'das sogs/

thugs phyag mtshan rnams snying ga'i hūm̐ la bstims nas/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas brgyud pa'i bka' bsgo dam bzhag rgyas par mdzad cing phyag dril gsil ba gnang*/ rjes 'dra ba spyi ltar ro// bram nag bshan pa drug skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ dzo ki kā ma rū pa/ zhang mdo sde pa/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ grang mo che pa/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i rjes gnang sngon chad snyan brgyud bzhugs pa las/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis tho mdor bsdus mdzad pa 'di lung bcas bzhugs shing 'di'i phyag len la gtor ma zur gsum gcig la chung ba lngas bskor ba gnyis bshams la/ dang po lhar bskyed pa la/ gnyis pa 'bul/ rgyun bshags gur nas gsungs pa/ mdun bskyed kye rdor sogs pa/ de'i steng du rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs/ bla ma kye rdor gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer mdun bskyed la phog pas bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis slob ma la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'od zer gyi phung por gyur pa de nyid hūm̐ las bram nag tu bskyed pa sogs/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od sogs gong bzhin gyi mgon po'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang dam tshig pa sogs/ yang gong bzhin gyi phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sogs mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas phyag mtshan slob ma'i snying ga'i hūm̐ sogs/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med du bsam sogs/ 'di bzhin gyi 'bab lugs rnam sras rkya brgyad skor la yang gnang byung ba phrin las pa rang gi dran tho 'di zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gam/

bram nag bshan pa drug skor ram/ nag po rdo rje bdud 'joms zhes bya ba bkra shis// ༈ /bram nag bshan pa drug bskor gyi rjes gnang bdud dpung mthar byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dpal mgon bram nag bshan pa drug bskor gyi rjes gnang la/ stegs kyi dbus su nas nag gi tshom bu che ba dang*/ mtha' skor du drug dgod/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar gtor ma zur gsum rtsa ba zlum po can che ba gcig la chung ba drug gis bskor ba la dar nag gi gdugs dang*/ 'byor na sku tsaka gzug mdun du 'bul gtor yi dam chos skyong la gnyis dang*/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ ḍa dril sogs bshams nas/ dpal kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed mngon lus rgyas pa'am/ yang na gtso rkyang bzlas pa bcas grub mtshams gtor chog mdzes rgyan bzhin yi dam la gtor ma dbul/ de nas mdun du rten a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun rten dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su pad nyi dang dgra bgegs kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can sku mdog nag po nas/ dpral bar oṃ bar gong bzhin dang*/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod nas bram ze nag po bshan pa drug dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzāḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo g.yab pa'am rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/

bi kā la rā tṛ ta sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ sngags gong ltar mthar sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dam rgya spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ sngags mthar sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag gis lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas gcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing thal mo brdab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la rā tṛ ta sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes gsum mam lngas gtor ma dbul/ gong ltar mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la rā tṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang*/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ hūm̐/ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can// rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings las bzhengs// dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba// tshangs skud rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi// bram ze'i gzugs khyod ti se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ ༈ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru// bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs// bran g.yog bshan pa drug dang bcas// sha chen zan dang me tog spos// chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ yungs kar/ gu gul/ dug tshil chen rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos bsreg cing*/ de ba pi tsu phreng skor gcig bzlas la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te gang bsgo ba nyan par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la rā tṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas mthar gong ltar mchod/ dpal ldan dbang ldan gyi tshig rkang bzhi par/ rab 'jigs bram ze'i gzugs can khyod la bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas bshags pa ni/ gang drin ma nas tshangs par stsal du gsol bar spyi ltar la/

he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo'i mjug tu dpal ldan sho lo ka gcig brjod pa ni khyad par ro// skang gso spro zhing nus na lha mchog mar kha bsgyur bas bya/ ༈ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnams kyang gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba ni/ dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i gang zag la/ ji skad du/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nag phyogs la dga' ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dag gis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bar chad byed pas/ de bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos/ srung ma la'ang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las/ dang pos ni tshe 'dir phan pa chung du tsam sgrub par nus kyang*/ log pa'i lam la sbyor ba dang*/ 'khu ldog phra mo tsam gyis lus srog la bar du gcod pa sogs nyes dmigs che zhing phan yon chung bas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de'ang rgyud sde rin po che rnams las chos skyong gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'di ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad pa'i rgyud las dngos su bstan pa/ stobs 'phrog nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa zhes kyang bya/ bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo zhes kyang bya ba ste/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa/ rgyal ba nyid kyis mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa/ 'phags yul mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu/ stong nyid smra ba'i seng ge slob dpon chen po 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyis rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid las legs par mnos te rgyud las phyung ba'i sgrub thabs bstod pa sogs mdzad pas klu sgrub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba'i srung mar grags/

des dzo ki kā ma rū pa la/ des zhang mdo sde pa la/ des 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan la/ des grong mo che pa la/ des rje btsun red mda' pa la/ des grub chen thang stong rgyal po la stsal ba nas bzung ste bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ gdams ngag gi srol ka ma nub pa/ phrin las kyi nus mthur ldan pa sha stag tu byon pa'i bram ze nag po bshan pa drug bskor gyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul mdzod/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// lan gsum/ rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed bram ze nag po 'khor bcas kyi steng du dpal kye rdo rje sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ de'i steng du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa/ mtha' skor kun tu sangs rgyas byang sems/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags pa sogs yan lag bdun pa mdzad snyam pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyis bsdus pa'i sdom pa rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rin po ches bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog bram ze'i gzugs can 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi byin gyis rlobs la rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi bsgrub pa'i slad du slob dpon nyid dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ mdun gyi bla rdo tshom bu dang bcas pa dbyer med pa'i dur khrod rol pa'i nas/ gdan gyi steng du dpal rdo rje nag po nas/ rngam zhing 'khrugs par gong ltar brjod/ de thams cad kyang sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs shing brjid la gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ gsung hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥk+ṣiṃ gi sgra grags stong skye ba med pa 'brug sgra stong ltar sgrogs pa/ thugs 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas bstan pa srung zhing dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i drag shul can/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i las la brtson pas mngon sum du mdun gyi gnas 'di nyid na bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig dang*/ phrin las dang*/ rten 'brel gyi dbang gis bzhugs pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes khyad par can mdzod cig de nas khyed rang gis slob dpon la mos gus drag po byas pas/ slob dpon kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba byung bas mdun gyi chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul te/

de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po sgra dang bcas pa zhig byung*/ shangs bug nas thon te khyed rang gi lus la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor nas kha nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas pa'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang bas las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dang*/ de las byung ba'i rnam smin gyi phung po/ ye shes kyi mes bsregs te dag par byas/ hūm̐ de'ang zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ de mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ de'ang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba'am/ me long la has btab pa bzhin yal bar mos nas sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du zhog mdzod/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang gang du gnas pa'i sar chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan gyi steng du khyed rang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes hūm̐ yig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i sogs nas/ shin tu rngam zhing 'khrugs pa bar gong bzhin dang*/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni rjes gnang gi gzhi bsgrub pa'o// rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba la sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon las kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam du mos gus khyad par can byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa 'phros/ mdun gyi stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gangs ti se/ shar lho bsil pa tshal gyi dur khrod/ siṅga la'i gling*/ ri bo po ta la/ byang shar ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod/ de wī ko ṭa'i ri sul/ tsā ri tra sogs yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa'i chos skyong gar bzhugs kyi gnas rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas stobs 'phrog nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can bshan pa drug sogs 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i sku che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba nas 'bru tsam gyi bar dpag tu med pa rngam brjid drag shul dang ldan pa/ gsung hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang k+ṣiṃ gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa dang bcas te byon nas/ khyed rang stobs 'phrog nag po chen por gsal ba'i lus kyi smin mtshams dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces dang*/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la rā tṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā we sha ya a a a/ zhes bzla zhing spos rol bya/ de ltar byas pas stobs 'phrog nag po chen po'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob cing*/ sku'i byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/ mthong ba tsam gyis gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod nus pa nag po chen po'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa yin snyam par mdzod cig de ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba'o// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i sogs nas/

nag po bram ze'i gzugs can gyi gsung gi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de nas slob dpon la sogs nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang rang bzhin gyi gnas rnams nas/ stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gsung gi ngo bo rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'bru gsum dang*/ ā li kā li la sogs pa'i sngags yig 'bru'i tshogs me 'od 'phro ba rang sgra drag po 'brug ltar sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa char babs pa bzhin byung ba khyed rang chos skyong du gsal ba'i lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags gong ltar bzla zhing spos rol bya/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar mgon po'i sngags kyis bskor ba 'od 'bar zhing gsal ba dang*/ khyed rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig 'od 'phro ba zhig bsgoms nas slob dpon la mos gus drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// khyed rang gis phul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas spyi gtsug tu bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces brjod la sngags bzla zhing phus btab pa'i me tog slob ma'i spyi bor 'thor te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ rig sngags kyi nus pa thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig

de ltar byas pas stobs 'phrog nag po chen po'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob cing*/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/ gsung bsgrags pa tsam gyis gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod nus pa nag po chen po'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa yin snyam pa mdzod cig de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'o// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i sogs nas 'od zer 'phros pas bar gong ltar la thugs kyi zhes bsgyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas rnams nas dpal ldan stobs 'phrog dbang po'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan ral gri dang*/ thod khrag rtse gsum/ rus phreng*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar byon nas lus kyi thad kar sleb pa dang*/ 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la sib sib thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags bzla zhing spos rol bya/ de ltar byas pas stobs 'phrog nag po chen po'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/ yid la dran pa tsam gyis gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod nus pa nag po chen po'i thugs dang rang gi yid dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa yin snyam pa mdzod cig de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma thogs te/ mdun gyi dur khrod rol pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i stobs 'phrog nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa slob ma'i spyi bor byon pa'i steng gi char rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams tho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ slob dpon gyis lag tu rdo rje thogs nas chos skyong gi thugs kar bzhag cing bka' bsgos pa ltar/

brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs gong ltar brjod nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags nas bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bar gyi rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig dang*/ bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin du lha chen nag po bram ze'i gzugs can/ 'khor bshan pa drug gi tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ khyad par du rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen las bzhi'i phrin las mtha' dag 'bad med du bsgrubs nas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas chos skyong 'khor bcas la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa'am/ bye ma la chu thim pa ltar sib sib thim pas lus thams cad 'od zer dang bdud rtsi sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis khrigs mer gyis gang nas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod cig ces brjod/ de nas yon tan sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas chos skyong 'dir dus gtor ma chag pa dang*/ snod ldan la dam du gdams shing*/

snod min la gsang ba dang*/ khyad par 'di dam tshig gi mgon po yin pas spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba dang*/ gzhan bya nag khyi nag mi nag la mi sdang ba rnams tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi mjug chog rnams spyi ltar bya'o// zhes bram nag bshan pa drug bskor gyi rjes gnang bdud dpung mthar byed ces bya ba 'di'ang dbang rab pa'i zin bris dang*/ tshar chen rin po che'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhin blo gter dbang pos bris pa'i dge bas lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
